## Requirements

List affected FR-xx, PR-xx or AT-xx IDs from `docs/requirements-v1.md`.

## Gates

List affected G0–G6 gates and the current evidence status.

## OpenSpec

Link `openspec/changes/<change-name>` or explain why no change applies.

## Contract and data changes

List changed bridge fields, persisted fields and migration behavior, or state None.

## Verification

List commands, results, skips and manual acceptance still pending. A passing PR does not by itself accept a release gate.
